hero.headline: Working tools.
hero.intro: A small collection of AI prompts, custom agents and skills, kept in one place. Copy what is useful: fill in the blanks on prompt templates and paste them into your AI tool, or save agent and skill files into a Claude Code project.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Prompts for coding, writing, analysis and more. Filter by category or AI tool.

agents.title: Custom Agents
agents.description: Subagent files for Claude Code. Save one into your project's .claude/agents folder and ask for it by name.

skills.title: Skills & Plugins
skills.description: Skills and plugins for Claude Code. Save a skill into .claude/skills, or assemble a plugin folder by hand.

header.label: How it works
header.title: Find it, fill it in, copy it.

items.title: Find
items.description: Browse by category or search by keyword. Prompts can also be filtered by AI tool.

items.title: Fill in
items.description: Some prompts are templates with blanks. Type your details in and the prompt updates as you go. Agents and skills have no blanks, but you can edit their files.

items.title: Copy
items.description: Press copy. Paste a prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or whichever tool you use, or paste an agent or skill into the file its page names.

about.label: About
about.headline: Hi, I'm Alec.
paragraphs: I made AI Hub to keep my prompts, custom agents and skills in one place and to share them. It is a personal project, so the collection is small and changes when I add to it.
If you have a prompt that works well, you can send it in.

items.question: What is this?
items.answer: A collection of AI prompts, plus custom agents and skills for Claude Code. Everything is on this site and there is no account to make.

items.question: How do I use a prompt?
items.answer: Open a prompt, press copy, and paste it into your AI tool. On templates, fill in the fields first and the prompt text updates to match.

items.question: Are the prompts free to use?
items.answer: Yes. You can use, change and share them for personal or commercial work. Credit is appreciated but not required.

items.question: Which AI tools do the prompts work with?
items.answer: Each prompt is tagged with the tool it was written for, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or MidJourney. They may behave differently in other tools.

items.question: What do agents and skills work with?
items.answer: They are written for Claude Code and use its file formats: subagent files for .claude/agents, and SKILL.md files for .claude/skills. They are not written for other AI tools.

items.question: Can I contribute a prompt?
items.answer: Yes. Use the submit a prompt page. I decide what gets added.

items.question: Can I ask for a prompt?
items.answer: Yes, send a request with the contact form. I can't promise when or whether I will write it.

items.question: Can I run my own copy of this site?
items.answer: Yes. The site is open source. The DIY Prompt Library page has the details.

header.label: Contact
header.title: Get in touch
header.description: A question, feedback or a prompt request. I will reply when I can.
